_note: MERCHANT_URL says WHERE the measurement client sends its requests — it is not an identity (see ../../docs/IDENTITY.md §1).
_note_hostname: A hostname is recommended instead of an IP address (e.g. http://x402.your-domain.example:3000): when the server's IP changes, the configuration does not need to be changed. You can also set the value with the MERCHANT_URL environment variable, which takes precedence over this file: MERCHANT_URL=http://x402.your-domain.example:3000 npm run mock
_note_wireshark: For a Wireshark capture use http:// (without TLS), otherwise 402, X-Payment and X-Signature are not visible in the capture. For a production TLS server use an https URL.
